Ayurvedic & Herbal Medicine

Standardized wisdom, rooted in a 5,000-year-old science.

Ayurveda — India's traditional system of herbal and natural medicine — treats the body as a whole, balancing the three doshas (Vata, Pitta, Kapha) through diet, lifestyle, and plant-based formulations rather than isolated symptom relief. At Rose Laboratories, this classical Ayurvedic knowledge is combined with modern, WHO-GMP certified manufacturing discipline, so every herbal and classical formulation we produce is both traditionally faithful and consistently standardized batch after batch.

Our catalogue spans proprietary Ayurvedic medicines, classical herbal formulations (Churna, Bhasma, Arishta, and medicated oils), and natural wellness products — manufactured from our certified facility in Fatuha, Patna, and trusted by pharmacies, practitioners, and institutional partners across India.

Where We Manufacture

A certified facility in Fatuha, Patna.

"Standardized Wisdom. Disciplined Science."

Our manufacturing unit operates out of the Fatuha Industrial Area in Patna, Bihar, under the NIC classification for manufacture of pharmaceuticals, medicinal chemical and botanical products. The facility is ZED Bronze certified under the MSME Sustainable (ZED) Certification Scheme and follows WHO-GMP compliant manufacturing practices across our proprietary and classical product lines.

Our Heritage

Four decades of formulation discipline.

1983

Founded by Ramesh Kumar Gupta & Usha Gupta

Rose Laboratories began as a small Ayurvedic manufacturing unit in Bihar, built on classical pharmacopoeia and family discipline.

Today

Led by Alok Gupta, Managing Director

Now under the stewardship of Managing Director Alok Gupta, with Ankur Gupta as Strategic Advisor, the unit has grown to 93 formulations across proprietary and classical lines.
